coordinates.billboard_note: Fist and stone bursts are screen-facing quads. Only their ground anchors are projected. Draw offsets in each asset compensate bottom-centre pivots; offsets scale with zoom.
coordinates.ground_note: Use owner brief ground squash0.5. World line300x80u becomes150x20px when horizontal,40x75px when vertical. Unprojected zoom-only footprint150x40px. Fissure48u wide is decorative and narrower than hit corridor80u.

sampling.padding_note: Three transparent texels INSIDE each cell edge; stride exactly frame width. Six clear texels across neighboring frames. Use UV cell rect; no inter-cell extra stride.
sampling.blend_note: Alpha composite every sheet so dark rock faces remain solid. Additive is unsuitable for the combined rock/light textures.

assets.placement_notes: Screen-facing at Fara fist/foot contact. Place geometric bottom-centre 14 screen px BELOW actual ground contact so ring centre sits on contact. Ground perspective is painted in; do not squash again. Final cel fades to zero over its 35ms hold.

Upright billboard at world line sample. Bottom-centre draw offset +2.5 screen px aligns painted base. Alternate A/B along line. Never rotate or ground-squash standing slabs. Fade final cel to zero during final 35ms; remove at local245ms.

Upright billboard at world line sample. Bottom-centre draw offset +2.5 screen px aligns painted base. Alternate A/B along line. Never rotate or ground-squash standing slabs. Fade final cel to zero during final 35ms; remove at local245ms.

Upright screen-facing billboard at fixed 300u line endpoint. Bottom-centre draw offset +5 screen px aligns painted base. Start at resolve450ms; first cel is local crack flash, peak towering slabs at510ms. Fade final cel to zero over its30ms hold. Ground projection affects anchor only.

Flat ground decal, native +X. World quad300x48u; project every vertex with zoom0.5 and ground-Y squash0.5. Horizontal line yields150x12px, vertical12x75px. Reveal by clipping UV and geometry at front distance, preserving texel scale. Optional client opacity pulse only; supplied1 frame.

sequence.timeline_origin: First fist/ground contact t=0. All times presentation recommendations; authoritative resolve event owns damage and knockback.
sequence.direction: Normalize target_world-origin_world when cast starts; latch origin and direction for whole sequence.

eruption.placement: origin + direction*sample_distance. First cel appears exactly when front passes; local peak after70ms. No full-line simultaneous stamp. Seven samples, no extra sample beyond300u.

crack.pulse: Optional opacity0.8..1.0 over120ms while travelling. No extra authored pulse frames.

screen_flash.notes: Optional single brief battlefield-only flash; exclude HUD. Remove under reduced-flash setting. No full-screen PNG supplied.

sequence.damage_and_knockback: At authoritative resolve (~450ms), every eligible victim on the line is hit and pushed by sim. Do not use each cosmetic sample as a separate damage event. No knockback distance invented.
draw_order: actors and eruptions sorted by ground contact Y
sequence.cancel: Remove front/decal and unspawned bursts on cast cancellation; follow authoritative event.
sequence.projection: Let d=(dx,dy) be unit world direction; n=(-dy,dx). Ground quad corners p=origin+d*s+n*v project as (0.5*p.x,0.25*p.y). Do not rotate an already squashed screen rectangle. Billboard height remains uncompressed.

preview.limits: Staged exact-texture composites at native logical game scale. Fara uses existing idle crop, not a newly painted punch pose. Enemy recoil offset illustrative only. No runtime screenshot or combat proof.
